principles_description: A flexible publishing workflow with WordPress content and a modern frontend.
principles:
CMS-managed publishing | Write articles, organise categories and tags, and choose featured images in WordPress. | Editorial control
Structured content delivery | Published content is delivered through the WordPress REST API and mapped to typed frontend data. | Clear content models
Publish and refresh | The frontend reads published content without caching, so saved changes appear on the next page refresh. | Up-to-date content
